name: Butterfly Sit-Up
steps: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet pressed together, knees dropped open wide, and arms extended straight overhead.
Engage your abs and curl your upper back smoothly off the floor while bringing your hands forward.
Sit all the way upright until your shoulders pass past your hip crease and your hands touch the floor in front of your feet.
Roll slowly back down vertebra by vertebra until your shoulder blades and hands touch behind your head.
tips: Keep the soles of your feet pressed lightly together and grounded throughout each repetition.
Initiate the lift with your abs rather than whipping your arms violently forward.
